question: ______ became the first Indian footballer to play in the UEFA Women's Champions League in 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manisha Kalyan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Manisha Kalyan.:-**

 
 
• **She became the first Indian footballer to play in the UEFA Women's Champions League in 2022.**
 
• Manisha Kalyan is a 20-year-old forward who plays for Rangers Women FC in Scotland.
 
• She had earlier played for Gokulam Kerala FC in the Indian Women's League. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pyari Xaxa:-**

 
 
• She is an Indian footballer who plays as a midfielder for the national team and has represented India at the Asian Games and SAFF Championship.
 
 
 
• **Ashalata Devi:-**
 
 
• She is also an Indian footballer who plays as a defender and has won the AIFF Women's Player of the Year award twice.
 
 
 
• **Jyoti Chouhan:-**
 
 
• She is an Indian footballer who plays as a forward and has represented India at the SAFF Championship and AFC Women's Asian Cup Qualifiers.
